hints.title: Subarray Prefix Deduplication
hints.text: Every subarray starting at index i extends rightward. Deduplicating distinct sequences avoids overcounting identical subarrays.

hints.title: Counting Divisible Elements on the Fly
hints.text: While expanding from start index i to j, increment divisible count whenever nums[j] is divisible by p.

hints.title: Prefix Tree for Unique Subarrays
hints.text: Inserting valid subarrays into a prefix tree automatically ensures each distinct sequence is counted exactly once.

hints.title: Prefix Tree Subarray Count Implementation

complexity.notes: At most O(n^2) prefix tree nodes inserted.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Hashing large tuples or strings repeatedly incurs string creation overhead.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Prefix tree nodes store each distinct subarray prefix once.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate manages both the divisibility threshold condition and sequence deduplication efficiently.
